<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Document → Order Parser (TEST / SANDBOX)
  PATH:   Other_NOT_FOR_PRODUCTION/Document_Order_Parser.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Drag-and-drop a customer PDF (purchase order / sales order) → extract its
  text → parse it into a structured order → review + edit → create the order
  in Fishbowl. First target doc type is "Sales Order" (an inbound customer PO
  that becomes one of our SOs); the parser is profile-driven so other doc
  types (Invoice, RMA, …) can be added later.

  PIPELINE
    1. Drop / browse a PDF (or an image).
    2. EXTRACT — PDF.js reads the embedded text layer (digital PDFs: instant,
       perfect). If a page has little/no text (scanned image), fall back to
       Tesseract.js OCR. A "Force OCR" toggle overrides. Images always OCR.
    3. PARSE — a text + word-geometry heuristic maps the page into header
       fields (customer, PO#, dates) and a line-item table (part · description
       · qty · uom · price · amount). Two-column "Bill To | Ship To" blocks
       are split by token x-position, then each block is decomposed into
       street / suburb / state / postcode / contact components. Wrapped
       description lines merge into the row above; missing unit prices are
       derived from amount ÷ qty.
    4. REVIEW — a Fishbowl-SO-styled General layout; every field editable.
    5. MATCH — rank all active customers by name similarity (auto-pick when
       confident, ranked suggestions otherwise); score the doc's ship-to /
       bill-to against the customer's addresses on file (bill-to defaults to
       the customer default unless the doc names a different one; an
       unmatched address is written from the doc's parsed components);
       resolve parts exact → customer part-number cross-ref (customerparts)
       → OCR-folded (O↔0, I/L↔1, S↔5, B↔8); validate each line's
       qty × price vs total and reconcile the summed lines against the
       document total, flagging discrepancies.
    6. CREATE — build the ImportSalesOrder CSV and POST it to
       /api/import/Sales-Order (runRestApiAsync), the SAME proven path
       QuickOrder.htm uses. There is NO REST POST /api/sales-orders (405).

  RUNTIME NOTES
    - PDF.js loads through a layered resolver: an optional self-hosted Fishbowl
      Script (offline) → a CDN → a UMD fallback. It is PINNED to a build that
      runs in Fishbowl's embedded browser (JxBrowser 8 / older Chromium) — the
      newest PDF.js uses JS the embedded browser lacks and throws mid-parse, so
      the loader also auto-downgrades at runtime if a too-new build is set.
      Tesseract.js loads from a CDN on first OCR (WASM + language data are
      multi-MB, so OCR is online-only); a digital PDF never touches it.
    - Fishbowl reports run from a data: URL (opaque origin), so a cross-origin
      Web Worker can't be constructed directly. We fetch the PDF.js worker and
      hand it to PDF.js as a blob URL (same-origin to the document). Tesseract
      already blob-wraps its own worker.
    - Shared chrome comes from the saved fb-lib Script + fb-styles Style
      (sources: scripts/fb-lib.js, scripts/fb-styles.css). Each directive is
      referenced exactly once, in the head, per Fishbowl's single-pass rule.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Document → Order Parser — Fishbowl BI</title>

    <!-- Inter (UI). Falls back to system fonts offline. -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Moment.js — date parsing/formatting for the header fields. -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI runtime — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved
         "fb-lib" script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. -->
    <script>
      {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — inlined from the saved "fb-styles"
         Style. Source of truth: scripts/fb-styles.css. MUST precede the
         page-specific <style> so local rules win on identical selectors. -->
    <style>
      {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-primary); background: var(--bg-1);
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom .12s ease;
        }
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* Drawer grid (settings/help). The drawer + its backdrop scrim are managed
           ENTIRELY by fb-lib / fb-styles (#fbDrawerScrim z-index 10000, .fb-drawer
           z-index 10001). Do NOT add a local scrim or override .fb-drawer's z-index
           — a lower value drops the drawer BELOW the scrim, greying it out and
           making it unclickable (the old Core-template trap). */
        .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
        .fb-group { flex: 1 1 240px; min-width: 220px; }
        .fb-group-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
            color: var(--c-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .fb-field.row { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* ── App shell: two resizable panes side by side. ── */
        .app-shell { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; gap: 0; }
        .pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; background: #fff; }
        .pane-left  { flex: 1 1 50%; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .pane-right { flex: 1 1 50%; background: var(--bg-1); }
        @media (max-width: 980px) { .app-shell { flex-direction: column; } .pane-left { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } }
        .pane-head { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fff; }
        .pane-head .step { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--menu-bg);
            color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .pane-head h2 { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .pane-head .grow { flex: 1; }
        .pane-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 16px; }
        .pane-right .pane-body { padding: 0; }

        /* ── Dropzone ── */
        .dropzone { border: 2px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--bg-1);
            padding: 44px 24px; text-align: center; color: var(--c-secondary); transition: .15s; cursor: pointer; }
        .dropzone.drag { border-color: var(--fb-blue); background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
        .dropzone svg { width: 46px; height: 46px; color: var(--c-tertiary); margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .dropzone.drag svg { color: var(--fb-blue); }
        .dropzone h3 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .dropzone p { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; }
        .dz-browse { color: var(--link); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }

        /* ── Viewer (after a file is loaded) ── */
        .filechip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
            background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; max-width: 100%; }
        .filechip svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .filechip .nm { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
        .viewer-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .pagenav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .pagenav b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        /* align-items:flex-start is REQUIRED — the stage is a flex row, and the
           default align-items:stretch stretched the canvas vertically to the
           380px stage, distorting the page's aspect ratio. flex-start lets the
           canvas keep its natural (rendered) proportions; tall pages scroll. */
        .viewer-stage { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--bg-2);
            overflow: auto; max-height: 420px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: 10px; }
        .viewer-stage canvas { max-width: 100%; height: auto; box-shadow: var(--sh1); background: #fff; }
        /* When zoomed past fit, anchor the page to the top-left so every edge is reachable by scroll
           (a centered flex child that overflows can't be scrolled back to its start edge). */
        .viewer-stage.zoomed { justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-start; cursor: grab; }
        .viewer-stage.zoomed:active { cursor: grabbing; }
        .zoomnav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
        .zoomnav #zoomLbl { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; }
        .extract-status { margin-top: 12px; }
        .prog { height: 8px; background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: var(--r-pill); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 6px; }
        .prog > div { height: 100%; background: var(--fb-blue); width: 0; transition: width .2s; }
        .text-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 14px 0 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .text-tab { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--c-secondary);
            font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
        .text-tab.active { color: var(--fb-blue); border-bottom-color: var(--fb-blue); }
        pre.textout { margin: 12px 0 0; background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card);
            padding: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--c-primary);
            max-height: 320px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

        /* ── Review (right pane) ── */
        .rv-scroll { padding: 16px; }
        .rv-empty { text-align: center; color: var(--c-tertiary); padding: 60px 20px; }
        .rv-empty svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; color: var(--border-strong); margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .rv-section { margin-bottom: 18px; }
        .rv-section h3 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em;
            color: var(--c-tertiary); margin: 0 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .rv-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 14px; }
        .rv-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
        .rv-field.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
        .rv-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .rv-field input, .rv-field textarea, .rv-field select {
            width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-btn);
            padding: 0 8px; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--c-primary); background: #fff; outline: none; }
        .rv-field textarea { height: auto; min-height: 54px; padding: 6px 8px; resize: vertical; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }
        .rv-field input:focus, .rv-field textarea:focus, .rv-field select:focus { border-color: var(--fb-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,.15); }

        table.items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
        table.items th { background: var(--menu-bg); color: #D5E4E8; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 7px 8px; white-space: nowrap; }
        table.items td { padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); vertical-align: middle; }
        table.items input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 28px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px;
            padding: 0 6px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--c-primary); background: transparent; outline: none; }
        table.items input:hover { border-color: var(--border); }
        table.items input:focus { border-color: var(--fb-blue); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,.12); }
        table.items td.num input { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        table.items .it-del { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--c-tertiary);
            cursor: pointer; border-radius: 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        table.items .it-del:hover { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: var(--fb-negative); }
        table.items .it-del svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
        /* The status chip lives in a real <td> — never make the cell inline-flex
           (that drops it out of the table column model and misaligns this column
           + the delete column). Keep it a normal centred cell and let the pill
           stay compact so it can't force the fixed-width column wider. */
        /* Keep the status cell a normal centred <td> (never inline-flex — that
           drops it out of the table column model and misaligns the row). */
        table.items td.it-status { text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
        /* Per-line tax-code dropdown. */
        table.items td.tax select { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px; font-family: inherit; padding: 0 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--c-primary); outline: none; }
        table.items td.tax select:focus { border-color: var(--fb-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,.12); }
        table.items td.tax { white-space: nowrap; }
        .items-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .items-foot .totals { margin-left: auto; text-align: right; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .items-foot .totals b { color: var(--c-primary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

        .rv-actions { position: sticky; bottom: 0; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .rv-actions .grow { flex: 1; }
        .match-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .cust-candidates { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-top: 6px; max-height: 160px; overflow: auto;
            border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: #fff; }
        .cust-cand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 9px; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); }
        .cust-cand:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .cust-cand:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
        .cust-cand.sel { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        .cust-cand .cc-name { flex: 1; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .cust-cand .cc-num { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }

        .banner { border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; gap: 9px; }
        .banner svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
        .banner.info { background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
        .banner.warn { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
        .banner.err  { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: #8A1E30; }
        .banner.ok   { background: var(--acc-sage); color: var(--fb-success); }

        /* ── Fishbowl-style SO layout (right pane, mirrors the client's SO General tab) ── */
        .so-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh1);
            padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .so-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        @media (max-width: 1280px) { .so-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .so-row .so-f:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }
        .so-f { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; }
        .so-f > .lbl { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); white-space: nowrap; }
        .so-f input, .so-f select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-btn);
            padding: 0 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--c-primary); background: #fff; outline: none; }
        .so-f input:focus, .so-f select:focus { border-color: var(--fb-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,.15); }
        .so-f .ro { flex: 1; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .so-custline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: -2px 0 8px; min-height: 20px; }
        .so-custline .row-link { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--link); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }
        .so-mid { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: stretch; margin-top: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .so-side { flex: 0 0 168px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; }
        .so-side .kv { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; background: var(--bg-1);
            border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; min-width: 0; }
        .so-side .kv .k { color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .so-side .kv .v { color: var(--c-primary); font-weight: 600; text-align: right; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

        /* Bill To / Ship To cards — blue header bar like the client. */
        .addr-card { flex: 1 1 240px; min-width: 230px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; }
        .addr-head { background: var(--fb-blue); color: #fff; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; }
        .addr-chipbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 6px 10px 0; min-height: 18px; }
        .addr-src { padding: 6px 10px 0; }
        .addr-body { padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex: 1; }
        .addr-body select { height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-btn); font-size: 12px;
            font-family: inherit; padding: 0 6px; max-width: 100%; background: #fff; color: var(--c-primary); outline: none; }
        .addr-lines { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--c-primary); padding: 2px 2px 2px; }
        .addr-f { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
        .addr-f > span { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .addr-f input { height: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 6px;
            font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--c-primary); outline: none; }
        .addr-f input:focus { border-color: var(--fb-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,.12); }
        .addr-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; }
        .addr-contact { padding: 0 10px 10px; }
        .addr-docsrc { padding: 4px 10px 8px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--c-tertiary); word-break: break-word; }

        /* Line-item validation flags. */
        table.items tr.it-warn td { background: #FBF4EC; }
        table.items td.ln { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        table.items td.cnum { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-secondary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
        .it-flag { color: var(--acc-orange-con); cursor: help; margin-left: 3px; font-weight: 700; }

        .hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); }
        .hidden { display: none !important; }

        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar, .pane-body::-webkit-scrollbar, .viewer-stage::-webkit-scrollbar,
        pre.textout::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .pane-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .viewer-stage::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
        pre.textout::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; }

        /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
           v1.2 layout: single main pane (the parsed order) + PDF preview in
           a slide-out drawer, plus the shared combobox / order-meta / totals
           chrome the review pane now uses.
           ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .hdr-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

        .main-pane { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: var(--bg-1); }
        .main-pane > #dropzone { max-width: 640px; margin: 60px auto; }
        .review-host { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 22px 0; }

        /* PDF preview drawer (right slide-in — the Production_Scheduling v1.2 pattern). */
        .pdf-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(16,16,16,.42); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity .2s; z-index: 1300; }
        .pdf-scrim.on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
        .pdf-drawer { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 560px; max-width: 94vw; background: #fff; z-index: 1301;
            box-shadow: -12px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.16); transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1);
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .pdf-drawer.on { transform: translateX(0); }
        .pdf-drawer-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
            padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .pdf-drawer-head h2 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .pdf-drawer-file { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); word-break: break-word; }
        /* The body is a flex column that never scrolls itself — the stage is the
           ONLY scroll container, so its horizontal + vertical scrollbars always
           sit at the stage's edges, inside the visible drawer (never pushed off
           screen by a tall zoomed page). */
        .pdf-drawer-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 16px 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .pdf-drawer .viewer-stage { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; max-height: none; }
        .close-x { width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--c-secondary);
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .close-x:hover { background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--fb-blue); }
        .close-x svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

(function wireDropzone() {

// Extract text from every page (embedded text preferred; OCR fallback), build
// the normalised model, then parse + render the review.
async function dpExtractPdf() {
    var gen = DP._gen;
    var forceOcr = !!S('forceOcr', false);
    var threshold = parseInt(S('ocrThreshold', 60), 10) || 0;
    var pages = [];
    var usedOcr = 0, usedText = 0;

    for (var i = 1; i <= DP.pageCount; i++) {
        setStatus('Extracting page ' + i + ' / ' + DP.pageCount + '…');
        setExtractStatus('<div class="hint">Extracting page ' + i + ' / ' + DP.pageCount + '…</div>');
        var page = await DP.pdf.getPage(i);
        var pageModel = null;

        if (!forceOcr) {
            var tc = await page.getTextContent();
            var textLen = tc.items.reduce(function (a, it) { return a + (it.str ? it.str.trim().length : 0); }, 0);
            if (textLen >= threshold) { pageModel = buildLinesFromPdfText(tc, page); usedText++; }
        }
        if (!pageModel) {

            var img = await rasterizePage(page, 2.2);
            pageModel = await ocrImage(img, i);
            usedOcr++;

        pages.push(pageModel);
    }
    if (gen !== DP._gen) return;   // cancelled (New document) mid-extract — don't commit stale results

    DP.model = { source: (usedOcr && !usedText) ? 'ocr' : (usedOcr ? 'mixed' : 'text'),

'' : 's') + '   ' + badge + '</div></div>');
    setStatus('Extracted — review the parsed order →');

async function rasterizePage(page, scale) {

// Run Tesseract on a data-URL image; return the normalised page model.
async function ocrImage(dataUrl, pageNo) {
    setStatus('Loading OCR engine…');

// ============================================================================
//  NORMALISED LINE MODELS
//  ----
//  Both extraction sources are reduced to the same shape:
//    { text, lines:[ { y, tokens:[ {text, x0, x1} ] } ] }
//  so the parser is source-agnostic. Coordinates are only ever compared
//  WITHIN one page/source, so the differing coordinate spaces (PDF text units
//  vs OCR pixels) never mix.
// ============================================================================
function buildLinesFromPdfText(tc, page) {
    var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
    var toks = [];
    tc.items.forEach(function (it) {
        var s = (it.str || '');
        if (!s.trim()) return;
        var tr = it.transform;              // [a,b,c,d,e,f]
        var x = tr[4];
        var yTop = vp.height - tr[5];        // flip so smaller = higher on page
        var w = it.width || (s.length * (tr[0] || 6) * 0.5);
        toks.push({ text: s.trim(), x0: x, x1: x + w, y: yTop, h: Math.abs(tr[3]) || 8 });
    });
    return groupTokensIntoLines(toks);
}

function buildLinesFromOcr(data) {
    // Tesseract reconstructs lines + words with bounding boxes. Produce the SAME
    // line shape the PDF path does — crucially each line needs a `.text` field
    // (the parser reads line.text); omitting it made image OCR throw
    // "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')".
    // Tesseract v4 exposes data.lines directly; v5 nests them under
    // data.blocks[].paragraphs[].lines[] — walk that when the flat list is empty.
    var srcLines = data.lines;
    if ((!srcLines || !srcLines.length) && data.blocks) {
        srcLines = [];
        (data.blocks || []).forEach(function (b) {
            (b.paragraphs || []).forEach(function (pr) {
                (pr.lines || []).forEach(function (ln) { srcLines.push(ln); });
            });
        });
    }
    var lines = [];
    (srcLines || []).forEach(function (ln) {
        var words = (ln.words || []).filter(function (w) { return w && w.text && w.text.trim(); });
        if (!words.length) return;
        var tokens = words.map(function (w) {
            var bb = w.bbox || {};
            return { text: w.text.trim(), x0: bb.x0 || 0, x1: bb.x1 || 0 };
        });
        lines.push({
            y: (ln.bbox && ln.bbox.y0 != null) ? ln.bbox.y0 : 0,
            tokens: tokens,
            text: tokens.map(function (t) { return t.text; }).join(' ')
        });
    });
    lines.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
    return { text: (data.text || '').replace(/\r/g, ''), lines: lines };
}

// Cluster PDF text tokens (which share a baseline per visual line) into lines.
function groupTokensIntoLines(toks) {
    toks.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y || a.x0 - b.x0; });
    var lines = [];
    var cur = null, curY = null, tol = 3;
    toks.forEach(function (t) {
        if (cur && Math.abs(t.y - curY) <= tol) {
            cur.tokens.push(t);
        } else {
            if (cur) lines.push(cur);
            cur = { y: t.y, tokens: [t] }; curY = t.y;
        }
    });
    if (cur) lines.push(cur);
    lines.forEach(function (l) {
        l.tokens.sort(function (a, b) { return a.x0 - b.x0; });
        l.text = l.tokens.map(function (t) { return t.text; }).join(' ');
    });
    var text = lines.map(function (l) { return l.text; }).join('\n');
    return { text: text, lines: lines };
}

// Column keyword sets (lowercased). Order within = priority when a token
// could match several. 'line' is a discard bucket — Fishbowl's own print (and
// many POs) lead with a line-number column ("#") that must not pollute the
// part number.
var COL_KEYS = {
    line:   ['line #', 'line no', 'line', '#'],
    part:   ['part number', 'part no', 'part #', 'item number', 'item no', 'item #', 'sku', 'product code', 'product no', 'product #', 'model', 'stock code', 'stock #', 'catalog', 'number', 'part', 'product'],
    desc:   ['description', 'desc', 'details', 'item description', 'product description', 'particulars'],
    qty:    ['quantity', 'qty ordered', 'order qty', 'qty', 'ordered', 'units'],
    uom:    ['uom', 'u/m', 'unit', 'units of measure'],
    tax:    ['tax code', 'tax rate', 'tax amount', 'tax %', 'gst', 'vat', 'tax'],
    price:  ['unit price', 'unit cost', 'price each', 'price/unit', 'u/price', 'rate', 'price', 'cost', 'each'],
    amount: ['extended', 'line total', 'ext price', 'ext amount', 'ext', 'amount', 'total', 'net amount', 'line amount', 'subtotal']

function centreOf(tok) { return (tok.x0 + tok.x1) / 2; }

// Find the header token anchoring a column keyword. Handles the keyword merged
// into one token ("Unit Price") AND split across tokens ("Unit" + "Price") —
// for a multi-word keyword a candidate token must be continued by the next
// token, so 'line total' can never anchor on the "Line" of a "Line #" column.
function findColAnchor(line, kw) {
    var words = kw.split(' ');
    for (var i = 0; i < line.tokens.length; i++) {
        var lo = line.tokens[i].text.toLowerCase();
        if (lo.indexOf(kw) === 0) return line.tokens[i];
        if (lo.indexOf(words[0]) !== 0) continue;
        if (words.length === 1) return line.tokens[i];
        var nxt = line.tokens[i + 1];
        if (nxt && nxt.text.toLowerCase().indexOf(words[1]) === 0) return line.tokens[i];
    }

// Find a line whose tokens contain the column headers; return a column map
// { colName: centreX } for the columns present.
function detectColumns(line, requiredGroups) {

            var tok = findColAnchor(line, keys[k]);
            if (tok) { found[col] = tok; return; }

    // column, not a UOM column; drop the false UOM hit.
    if (found.uom && /price|cost|rate|total|amount/i.test(found.uom.text)) delete found.uom;
    // Two columns anchored to the SAME token → keep the more load-bearing one.
    var PRIORITY = ['qty', 'amount', 'price', 'tax', 'part', 'desc', 'line', 'uom'];
    var used = [];
    PRIORITY.forEach(function (col) {
        var t = found[col];

    // Trust the header only when each required column-group has ≥1 hit. The
    // default gate (qty + price/amount + part/desc) suits sell-side tables; a

// Match a parsed hint — a code ("GST"), a percentage ("10%" / "10"), or a
// fraction ("0.1") — to a sales tax rate: by rate first, then code, then name.
function matchTaxRate(hint) {
    var rates = DP.taxRates || [];
    if (!rates.length) return null;
    var h = String(hint == null ? '' : hint).trim();
    if (!h) return null;
    var pm = h.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%/) || (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(h) ? [null, h] : null);
    if (pm) {
        var v = parseFloat(pm[1]);
        if (!isNaN(v)) {
            var frac = v > 1 ? v / 100 : v;   // "10" → 0.1, "0.1" → 0.1
            var byRate = rates.find(function (r) { return Math.abs((r.rate || 0) - frac) < 0.0005; });
            if (byRate) return byRate;
        }
    }
    var hl = h.toLowerCase();
    var byCode = rates.find(function (r) { return (r.code || '').toLowerCase() === hl; });
    if (byCode) return byCode;
    var byName = rates.find(function (r) { return (r.name || '').toLowerCase() === hl; });
    if (byName) return byName;
    var byPart = rates.find(function (r) { return (r.code || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(hl) >= 0 || (r.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(hl) >= 0; });
    return byPart || null;
}
// Resolve an order-level default tax code (doc effective rate → explicit code in

// Tax column token, when parsed, overrides the default for that line.

    var P = DP.parsed; if (!P) return;

    var t = P.totals || {};
    if (t.subtotal && t.subtotal > 0 && t.tax != null) def = matchTaxRate(String(t.tax / t.subtotal));
    if (!def) { var cm = (P.rawText || '').match(/\b(GST|VAT|HST|PST|QST)\b/i); if (cm) def = matchTaxRate(cm[1]); }
    if (!def) def = rates.find(function (r) { return r.rate > 0; }) || rates[0] || null;
    DP.defaultTaxCode = def ? def.code : '';
    (P.lineItems || []).forEach(function (it) {
        if (it.taxCode != null) return;   // already resolved / user-set
        var m = (it.taxHint || '').trim() ? matchTaxRate(it.taxHint) : null;

// Rank every active customer by name similarity. Auto-pick when the top score
// is confident AND clearly ahead of #2; otherwise surface the ranked list
// (which stays visible even after a pick, so one click switches).
async function matchCustomer() {
    var name = (DP.parsed.customerName || '').trim();
    if (!name) { showToast('No customer name to match — fill it in first.', 'warn'); renderReview(); return; }
    var all = await loadCustomersOnce();
    var scored = all.map(function (c) { return { id: c.id, num: c.num, name: c.name, accountId: c.accountId, score: custScore(name, c.name) }; })
                    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; });
    var top = scored.slice(0, 6).filter(function (c) { return c.score > 0.2; });
    DP._candCache = top;
    if (!top.length) {
        DP.selectedCustomer = null;
        showToast('No customer resembles "' + name + '" — edit the name and re-match.', 'error', 6000);
        renderReview();
        return;
    }
    // Always take the best candidate — even a weak (~50%) match beats leaving it
    // blank; the confidence badge turns orange below 70% (see renderReview), and
    // the ranked list stays in the combobox for a one-click switch.
    await dpPickCustomer(top[0], true);
}

// Score the doc's parsed ship-to / bill-to against the customer's addresses on
// file and set each card's source + selection:
//   · ship-to — best on-file match ≥ 0.6 wins; else "from document" (the doc's
//     parsed components are written onto the order).
//   · bill-to — stays on the customer's DEFAULT unless the doc names a bill-to
//     that differs from its ship-to; then match it (or fall to "from document").
function autoMatchAddresses() {
    var P = DP.parsed || {};
    var sp = P.shipToParsed, bp = P.billToParsed;
    var hasDoc = function (c) { return !!(c && (c.street || c.zip || c.city)); };
    // Ship-to.
    DP.ship = { source: 'file', fileId: DP.shipToId, match: null, provided: hasDoc(sp) };
    if (hasDoc(sp)) {
        if (DP.addresses.length) {
            var best = null;
            DP.addresses.forEach(function (a) { var s = addrScore(sp, a); if (!best || s > best.score) best = { id: a.id, score: s }; });
            if (best && best.score >= 0.6) { DP.ship.fileId = best.id; DP.shipToId = best.id; DP.ship.match = best; }
            else DP.ship.source = 'doc';
        } else DP.ship.source = 'doc';
    }
    // Bill-to — customer default unless the doc provides a DIFFERENT bill-to.
    DP.bill = { source: 'file', fileId: DP.billToId, match: null, provided: hasDoc(bp) };
    if (DP.bill.provided) {
        var sameAsShip = hasDoc(sp) && diceSim(normName(bp.raw || ''), normName(sp.raw || '')) > 0.9;
        if (!sameAsShip) {
            if (DP.addresses.length) {
                var bb = null;
                DP.addresses.forEach(function (a) { var s = addrScore(bp, a); if (!bb || s > bb.score) bb = { id: a.id, score: s }; });
                if (bb && bb.score >= 0.6) { DP.bill.fileId = bb.id; DP.billToId = bb.id; DP.bill.match = bb; }
                else DP.bill.source = 'doc';
            } else DP.bill.source = 'doc';
        }
        // same-as-ship ⇒ not "specifically different" — keep the customer default.
    } else if (!DP.addresses.length && hasDoc(sp)) {
        DP.bill.source = 'doc';   // nothing on file at all — bill from the doc's ship block
        P.billToParsed = P.billToParsed && hasDoc(P.billToParsed) ? P.billToParsed : sp;
    }
}

function bitTrue(v) { return v === 1 || v === '1' || v === true || v === 'true'; }

// Part matching — three stages, each only over the numbers the prior stage
// left unresolved:
//   1. EXACT   part.num ∪ product.num.
//   2. CUSTREF the selected customer's part-number cross-reference
//              (customerparts.customerPartNumber → product) — customer POs
//              routinely use THEIR part numbers. The doc's number moves into
//              the line's Customer # and our product number takes its place.
//   3. FOLDED  OCR-confusable folding on both sides (O↔0, I/L↔1, S↔5, B↔8,
//              spaces/dashes dropped) so a misread digit still resolves.
async function matchParts() {
    var P = DP.parsed; if (!P) return;
    P.lineItems.forEach(function (it) { if (!(it.partNum || '').trim()) it._match = undefined; });
    var nums = Array.from(new Set(P.lineItems.map(function (it) { return (it.partNum || '').trim(); }).filter(Boolean)));
    if (!nums.length) return;
    var byKey = new Map();   // lowercase doc number → match
    var inList = nums.map(function (n) { return "'" + escSql(n) + "'"; }).join(',');
    try {
        // A sales order sells PRODUCTS — resolve the Number column against
        // product.num (not part.num) so an exact hit auto-marks matched and the
        // SO import gets a valid ProductNumber.
        (await qp(
            "SELECT pr.num AS num, pr.description AS description FROM product pr WHERE pr.activeFlag = 1 AND pr.num IN (" + inList + ")"
        )).forEach(function (r) {
            var k = String(r.num).toLowerCase();
            if (!byKey.has(k)) byKey.set(k, { ok: true, via: 'exact', partNum: r.num, description: r.description });
        });
    } catch (e) { debugLog('Product exact-match query failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'warn'); }

    var unres = nums.filter(function (n) { return !byKey.has(n.toLowerCase()); });
    if (unres.length && DP.selectedCustomer) {
        try {
            var in2 = unres.map(function (n) { return "'" + escSql(n) + "'"; }).join(',');
            (await qp(
                "SELECT cp.customerPartNumber AS cnum, pr.num AS num, pr.description AS description " +
                "FROM customerparts cp JOIN product pr ON pr.id = cp.productId " +
                "WHERE cp.customerId = " + parseInt(DP.selectedCustomer.id, 10) + " AND cp.customerPartNumber IN (" + in2 + ")"
            )).forEach(function (r) {
                var k = String(r.cnum).toLowerCase();
                if (!byKey.has(k)) byKey.set(k, { ok: true, via: 'custref', partNum: r.num, description: r.description });
            });
        } catch (e) { debugLog('customerparts lookup skipped: ' + (e && e.message), 'warn'); }
    }

    unres = nums.filter(function (n) { return !byKey.has(n.toLowerCase()); });
    if (unres.length) {
        try {
            var foldMap = new Map();
            unres.forEach(function (n) { var f = foldPart(n); if (f) foldMap.set(f, n); });
            if (foldMap.size) {
                var in3 = Array.from(foldMap.keys()).map(function (n) { return "'" + escSql(n) + "'"; }).join(',');
                var FE = "REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(num),' ',''),'-',''),'O','0'),'I','1'),'L','1'),'S','5'),'B','8')";
                (await qp(
                    "SELECT num, description FROM product WHERE activeFlag = 1 AND " + FE + " IN (" + in3 + ")"
                )).forEach(function (r) {
                    var orig = foldMap.get(foldPart(String(r.num)));
                    if (orig && !byKey.has(orig.toLowerCase())) byKey.set(orig.toLowerCase(), { ok: true, via: 'fuzzy', partNum: r.num, description: r.description });
                });
            }
        } catch (e) { debugLog('Folded part match skipped: ' + (e && e.message), 'warn'); }
    }

    P.lineItems.forEach(function (it) {
        var k = (it.partNum || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!k) { it._match = undefined; return; }
        var m = byKey.get(k) || { ok: false };
        it._match = m;
        // Normalise the line onto OUR number: a customer-ref match records the
        // doc's number as the Customer #, an OCR/case correction just swaps in
        // the canonical spelling. (A re-run then exact-matches.)
        if (m.ok && m.partNum && String(m.partNum).toLowerCase() !== k) {
            if (m.via === 'custref' && !it.customerNum) it.customerNum = it.partNum.trim();
            it.partNum = m.partNum;
        }
    });
}

function refreshCreateGate() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('createBtn');
    var hintEl = document.getElementById('createHint');
    if (!btn) return;
    var _lo = DP.profile && DP.profile.review && DP.profile.review.layout;
    if (_lo === 'receiving') return refreshCreateGateVendor();
    if (_lo === 'price-list') return refreshCreateGatePriceList();
    var P = DP.parsed || {};
    var reasons = [], warns = [];
    if (!DP.selectedCustomer) reasons.push('match a customer');
    // An address source is valid when it's an on-file selection OR a doc
    // address with enough parsed substance (street + suburb/postcode).
    var okAddr = function (st, doc) {
        if (!st) return false;
        if (st.source === 'doc') { var d = doc || {}; return !!((d.street || d.name) && (d.city || d.zip)); }
        return st.fileId != null;
    };
    if (DP.selectedCustomer) {
        if (!okAddr(DP.ship, P.shipToParsed)) reasons.push('complete the ship-to address');
        if (!okAddr(DP.bill, P.billToParsed)) reasons.push('complete the bill-to address');
    }
    var items = P.lineItems || [];
    if (!items.length) reasons.push('add at least one line');
    var unmatched = items.filter(function (it) { return (it.partNum || '').trim() && it._match && it._match.ok === false; }).length;
    if (S('blockUnmatched', true) && unmatched > 0) reasons.push(unmatched + ' part(s) not found');
    // Non-blocking review flags.
    var recon = reconcileTotals();
    if (recon.status === 'warn')
        warns.push('<span class="spill caution" title="' + esc('Sum of lines ' + money(recon.sum) + ' vs document ' + recon.refLabel + ' ' + money(recon.ref)) + '">totals differ Δ ' + money(Math.abs(recon.delta)) + '</span>');
    if (!S('blockUnmatched', true) && unmatched > 0)
        warns.push('<span class="spill caution">' + unmatched + ' part(s) unmatched — Fishbowl may reject them</span>');
    if (DP.selectedCustomer && DP.ship && DP.ship.source === 'doc')
        warns.push('<span class="spill caution" title="The ship-to will be written from the document, not an address on file">doc ship-to</span>');
    btn.disabled = reasons.length > 0;
    btn.title = reasons.length ? ('First: ' + reasons.join(', ')) : 'Create the sales order in Fishbowl';
    if (hintEl) hintEl.innerHTML = reasons.length ? esc(reasons[0]) : warns.join(' ');
}

// ============================================================================
//  VENDOR DOC TYPES  —  parse + match + receiving import
//  ----
//  Shared by the vendor-receiving / vendor-invoice profiles. A vendor document
//  (delivery docket, invoice, quote) is the mirror of a sales order: the SELLER
//  (vendor) is on the letterhead and WE are the bill-to. It cites one of OUR
//  purchase orders; the goal is to receive the listed quantities against that PO.
// ============================================================================

// Parse a vendor document into { vendorName, poNumber, orderDate, lineItems, totals }.
function parseVendorDoc(model) {
    var text = model.fullText || '';
    var lines = text.split('\n').map(function (s) { return s.replace(/\s+$/, ''); });
    var prof = DP.profile || PROFILES['vendor-receiving'];

    // Our PO number the vendor is delivering / billing against.
    var poNumber = firstMatch(text, [
        /\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?|purchase\s*order)\s*(?:number|no\.?|num|#)?\s*[:#]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-\/_.]{2,})/i,
        /\b(?:your\s*order|order\s*(?:number|no\.?|#)|customer\s*po)\s*[:#]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-\/_.]{2,})/i
    ]);
    if (poNumber && (/^date$/i.test(poNumber) || !/\d/.test(poNumber))) poNumber = '';
    if (!poNumber) {
        poNumber = geoLabelValue(model, [/^(?:p\.?o\.?|purchase\s*order|order|your\s*order)\s*(?:#|no\.?|number)?$/i], function (v) {
            var w = v.split(/\s+/)[0]; return /\d/.test(w) && /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-\/_.]*$/.test(w);
        });
        if (poNumber) poNumber = poNumber.split(/\s+/)[0];
    }
    // Fishbowl's PO/invoice print puts "Order # | Date" as adjacent columns with
    // the values on the line below ("P438   14/07/2026"). The stylized "Order #"
    // title often OCRs to garbage, so as a last resort grab a short order-ish
    // token sitting to the LEFT of a date near the top of the page.
    if (!poNumber) {
        var pg0 = (model.pages && model.pages[0]) || { lines: [] };
        var pageH = 0; pg0.lines.forEach(function (l) { if (l.y > pageH) pageH = l.y; });
        var dRe = /^\d{1,2}[\/\-.]\d{1,2}[\/\-.]\d{2,4}$/;
        for (var pgi = 0; pgi < pg0.lines.length; pgi++) {
            var ln0 = pg0.lines[pgi];
            if (pageH && ln0.y > pageH * 0.30) continue;                 // header region only
            var dtok = null;
            ln0.tokens.forEach(function (t) { if (!dtok && dRe.test(t.text)) dtok = t; });
            if (!dtok) continue;
            var cands = ln0.tokens.filter(function (t) { return t.x1 <= dtok.x0 && /\d/.test(t.text) && /^(?:PO[-]?|P|#)?\d{2,8}$/i.test(t.text); });
            if (cands.length) { poNumber = cands[cands.length - 1].text.replace(/^#/, ''); break; }
        }
    }

    var docDate = findDateNear(text, ['invoice date', 'docket date', 'delivery date', 'date'])
        || normDate(geoLabelValue(model, [/^date$/i], function (v) { return !!normDate(v); }));

    // Vendor = the seller on the letterhead. Prefer an explicit From/Vendor/
    // Supplier label; else the first substantial line at the top of the page
    // that isn't the document title.
    var vendorName = firstMatch(text, [/\b(?:vendor|supplier|from)\s*[:#]\s*(.+)/i]);
    if (vendorName) vendorName = vendorName.split(/\s+(?:abn|acn|phone|fax|email|a\.b\.n)\s*[.:#]/i)[0].trim();
    if (!vendorName) {
        var top = lines.find(function (l) {
            var t = l.trim();
            if (t.length <= 2 || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(t)) return false;
            if (/[\[\]|]/.test(t) || /:$/.test(t)) return false;   // OCR table-border garbage, or a label line ("Ship To:")
            if (/^(tax\s*invoice|invoice|quote|quotation|delivery|packing|docket|purchase|statement|remittance|order|date)\b/i.test(t)) return false;
            var letters = (t.match(/[A-Za-z]/g) || []).length;
            return letters >= t.replace(/\s/g, '').length * 0.5;   // mostly letters — not a number/date row
        });
        vendorName = (top || '').trim();
    }

    // Line items — the generic column engine with THIS profile's required cols
    // (a docket has no price column; a price list has no qty).
    var items = [], colMap = null;
    model.pages.forEach(function (pg) {
        var started = colMap != null;
        for (var i = 0; i < pg.lines.length; i++) {
            var ln = pg.lines[i];
            if (!started || !colMap) { var m = detectColumns(ln, prof.requiredCols); if (m) { colMap = m; started = true; continue; } }
            if (!started || !colMap) continue;
            if (stopLine(ln.text)) { started = false; continue; }
            var row = rowFromColumns(ln, colMap);
            if (isItemRow(row, ln)) items.push(row);
            else if (items.length && row.qty == null && row.unitPrice == null && row.amount == null) {
                var cont = ((row.partNum ? row.partNum + ' ' : '') + (row.description || '')).trim();
                if (cont && cont.length <= 90 && !/^page\s+\d+/i.test(cont))
                    items[items.length - 1].description = (items[items.length - 1].description + ' ' + cont).trim();
            }
        }
    });
    if (!items.length) items = looseLineItems(lines);

    items.forEach(function (it) {
        // Recover a missing qty from amount ÷ unit cost (a merged/misread qty cell).
        if (it.qty == null && it.unitPrice != null && it.amount != null && it.unitPrice !== 0) {
            var dq = it.amount / it.unitPrice;
            if (isFinite(dq) && dq > 0) { it.qty = Math.round(dq * 1000) / 1000; it._derivedQty = true; }
        }
        if (it.qty != null && it.qty > 0) {
            if (it.unitPrice == null && it.amount != null) { it.unitPrice = Math.round(it.amount / it.qty * 10000) / 10000; it._derivedPrice = true; }
            else if (it.amount == null && it.unitPrice != null) { it.amount = Math.round(it.qty * it.unitPrice * 100) / 100; it._derivedAmount = true; }
        }
    });

    var tScan = parseTotalsFromLines(lines);
    return {
        vendorName: vendorName || '', poNumber: poNumber || '', vendorPo: '',
        orderDate: docDate || '', shipDate: '',
        lineItems: items,
        totals: { subtotal: tScan.subtotal, tax: tScan.tax, total: tScan.total },
        rawText: text
    };
}

        "poi.description AS description, (COALESCE(poi.qtyToFulfill,0) - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled,0)) AS outstanding, " +
        "poi.unitCost AS unitcost, poi.mcUnitCost AS mcunitcost, u.code AS uom " +
        "FROM po JOIN poitem poi ON poi.poId = po.id " +
        "LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = poi.partId LEFT JOIN uom u ON u.id = poi.uomId LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.id = po.currencyId " +
        "WHERE po.vendorId = " + parseInt(vendorId, 10) + " AND po.statusId IN (20,30,40,50,55) " +
        "AND poi.statusId IN (10,20,30,40,45) AND poi.partId IS NOT NULL " +

// PO currency metadata → { currencyId, currencyRate, currencyCode, isForeign }.
// A PO is "foreign" when it carries a currency that isn't the home currency;
// then poitem.mcUnitCost (PO currency) is authoritative and poitem.unitCost is
// the home-currency conversion (home = mc × currencyRate).
function poCurrencyMeta(r) {
    var isForeign = (r.currencyid != null) && !bitTrue(r.ishome);
    return { currencyId: (r.currencyid != null ? r.currencyid : null), currencyRate: Number(r.currencyrate) || 1,
             currencyCode: r.currencycode || '', isForeign: isForeign };
}
function poItemFromRow(r) {
    return { poItemId: r.poitemid, lineNo: r.lineno, partId: r.partid, snapshotNum: r.snapshotnum,
        realNum: r.realnum || r.snapshotnum, description: r.description, outstanding: Number(r.outstanding) || 0,
        unitCost: Number(r.unitcost) || 0, mcUnitCost: (r.mcunitcost != null ? Number(r.mcunitcost) : null), uom: r.uom || 'ea' };
}

// Does any line on this PO resolve to the given folded doc token?
function poLineMatchesToken(po, foldedTok) {
    var hit = DP.vendorPartIndex && DP.vendorPartIndex[foldedTok];
    return po.items.some(function (pi) {
        if (foldPart(String(pi.realNum || '')) === foldedTok) return true;
        if (foldPart(String(pi.snapshotNum || '')) === foldedTok) return true;
        if (hit && String(hit.partId) === String(pi.partId)) return true;
        return false;
    });
}
function coverageCount(po) {
    var P = DP.parsed || {}, n = 0;
    (P.lineItems || []).forEach(function (it) { var raw = (it.partNum || '').trim(); if (raw && poLineMatchesToken(po, foldPart(raw))) n++; });
    return n;
}
// Match a PO reference tolerantly — a vendor doc may print "P438" for our PO
// "438" (or vice-versa), so ignore a leading P / PO / PO- / # and any spaces.
function poRefMatches(docRef, poNum) {
    var a = String(docRef == null ? '' : docRef).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    var b = String(poNum == null ? '' : poNum).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    if (a === b) return true;
    var strip = function (x) { return x.replace(/^(?:po[-]?|p|#)/, ''); };
    var as = strip(a), bs = strip(b);
    return as === bs || a === bs || as === b;
}
// Rank candidate POs: an exact PO-number cite dominates, then how many of the
// doc's parts appear on the PO. Pre-select the winner (user can override via the
// picker). When the PO number couldn't be OCR'd, part-coverage alone identifies
// the PO and the inferred number is filled back in. Never auto-pick a PO that
// has neither a number match nor a single matching part.
function rankAndSelectPO() {
    if (!DP.openPOs || !DP.openPOs.length) { DP.selectedPO = null; return; }
    var P = DP.parsed || {};
    var refs = [P.poNumber, P.vendorPo].filter(Boolean);
    DP.openPOs.forEach(function (po) {
        var s = 0;
        if (refs.some(function (r) { return poRefMatches(r, po.num); })) s += 1000;
        po._cov = coverageCount(po);
        s += po._cov;
        po._score = s;
    });
    DP.openPOs.sort(function (a, b) { return (b._score - a._score) || (String(a.num) < String(b.num) ? -1 : 1); });
    var best = DP.openPOs[0];
    if (best && best._score > 0) {
        DP.selectedPO = best;
        // OCR couldn't read the PO number but the doc's parts matched this PO →
        // infer the number and surface it in the Doc Ref field.
        if (!((P.poNumber || '').trim()) && best._cov > 0) P.poNumber = best.num;
    } else {
        DP.selectedPO = null;   // no number match and no part on any open PO — let the user pick
    }
}
// Match each parsed line to a poItem on the selected PO: real part # (folded) →
// vendor part # (folded) → snapshot part # (folded). Seeds recvQty = min(docQty,
// outstanding) (or the full outstanding when the doc omits a qty).
function matchReceivingLines() {
    var P = DP.parsed; if (!P) return;
    var po = DP.selectedPO;
    P.lineItems.forEach(function (it) {
        it._poMatch = null;
        var raw = (it.partNum || '').trim();
        if (!raw || !po) { it._match = raw ? { ok: false } : undefined; return; }
        var f = foldPart(raw);
        var m = po.items.find(function (pi) {
            return String(pi.realNum || '').toLowerCase() === raw.toLowerCase() ||
                foldPart(String(pi.realNum || '')) === f || foldPart(String(pi.snapshotNum || '')) === f;
        });
        if (!m && DP.vendorPartIndex && DP.vendorPartIndex[f]) {
            var hit = DP.vendorPartIndex[f];
            m = po.items.find(function (pi) { return String(pi.partId) === String(hit.partId); });
            if (m && !it.vendorNum) it.vendorNum = raw;
        }
        if (m) {
            it._poMatch = m;
            it._match = { ok: true, via: 'po', partNum: m.realNum };
            if (it.recvQty == null) {
                var want = (it.qty != null && it.qty > 0) ? it.qty : m.outstanding;
                it.recvQty = Math.max(0, Math.min(want, m.outstanding));
            }
        } else {
            it._match = { ok: false };
        }
    });
}

// Direct PO lookup by number, independent of the matched vendor. Tries the

async function dpLoadPoByNumber(num) {

        "po.currencyId AS currencyid, po.currencyRate AS currencyrate, cur.code AS currencycode, COALESCE(cur.homeCurrency+0,1) AS ishome, " +
        "poi.id AS poitemid, poi.poLineItem AS lineno, poi.partId AS partid, poi.partNum AS snapshotnum, p.num AS realnum, " +
        "poi.description AS description, (COALESCE(poi.qtyToFulfill,0) - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled,0)) AS outstanding, " +
        "poi.unitCost AS unitcost, poi.mcUnitCost AS mcunitcost, u.code AS uom " +
        "FROM po JOIN vendor v ON v.id = po.vendorId JOIN poitem poi ON poi.poId = po.id " +
        "LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = poi.partId LEFT JOIN uom u ON u.id = poi.uomId LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.id = po.currencyId " +
        "WHERE po.num IN (" + inList + ") AND po.statusId IN (20,30,40,50,55) " +
        "AND poi.statusId IN (10,20,30,40,45) AND poi.partId IS NOT NULL " +
        "AND (COALESCE(poi.qtyToFulfill,0) - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled,0)) > 0 ORDER BY poi.poLineItem");
    if (!rows.length) {

    }
    var po = Object.assign({ poid: rows[0].poid, num: rows[0].ponum, statusId: rows[0].postatus, items: [] }, poCurrencyMeta(rows[0]));
    rows.forEach(function (r) { po.items.push(poItemFromRow(r)); });

    }

    matchReceivingLines();

    renderReview();
}

// Expected-cost sources for the matched PO parts (invoice price validation).

        .filter(function (it) { return it._poMatch && it._poMatch.partId != null; })
        .map(function (it) { return parseInt(it._poMatch.partId, 10); })));

            " ORDER BY vp.defaultFlag DESC, vp.lastDate DESC LIMIT 1) AS vendorcost " +
            "FROM part p LEFT JOIN partcost pc ON pc.partId = p.id WHERE p.id IN (" + ids.join(',') + ")");
        rows.forEach(function (r) {

// Invoice price-validation panel (display only — never imported). Compares each
// matched line's invoice unit price against the expected cost: matched PO unit
// cost → vendor lastCost → part stdCost (avgCost shown muted, never the base).
function priceValidationHtml() {
    var P = DP.parsed; if (!P) return '';
    var pct = parseFloat(S('priceVarPct', 5)) || 0, abs = parseFloat(S('priceVarAbs', 1.0)) || 0;
    var ec = DP.expectedCosts || {};
    // Multi-currency: the invoice is priced in the PO's currency, so compare in
    // it. poitem.mcUnitCost + vendorparts.lastCost are ALREADY the PO/vendor
    // currency; part std/avg cost are HOME currency (home = fx × rate ⇒ fx =
    // home / rate). fm() renders every figure in the PO currency (by ISO code).
    var po = DP.selectedPO || {};
    var foreign = !!po.isForeign, code = po.currencyCode || '', rate = po.currencyRate || 1;
    var fm = function (v) { return v == null ? '—' : (foreign ? fmtCur(v, code) : moneyc(v)); };

//  Shared by vendor-price-list (→ vendorparts) and customer-price-list
//  (→ customerparts). Same layout, differing only by entity config (which

//  has no qty and no PO — just "their part number", description, and a price.

// Parse a price list into { vendorName|customerName, lineItems:[{partNum, description, unitPrice, uom}] }.
function parsePriceList(model) {
    var text = model.fullText || '';
    var lines = text.split('\n').map(function (s) { return s.replace(/\s+$/, ''); });
    var prof = DP.profile || PROFILES['vendor-price-list'];

    var entName = firstMatch(text, [/\b(?:vendor|supplier|customer|account|from|for)\s*[:#]\s*(.+)/i]);
    if (entName) entName = entName.split(/\s+(?:abn|acn|phone|fax|email|a\.b\.n)\s*[.:#]/i)[0].trim();
    if (!entName) {
        var top = lines.find(function (l) {
            var t = l.trim();
            return t.length > 2 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(t) && !/^(customer\s+)?(price\s*list|price\s*schedule|pricelist)\b/i.test(t);
        });
        entName = (top || '').trim();
    }
    // A letterhead often trails the document title — drop "… Price List/Schedule".
    entName = entName.replace(/\s*[-–—:]*\s*(customer\s+)?price\s*(list|schedule)\s*$/i, '').trim();

    var items = [], colMap = null;
    model.pages.forEach(function (pg) {
        var started = colMap != null;
        for (var i = 0; i < pg.lines.length; i++) {
            var ln = pg.lines[i];
            if (!started || !colMap) { var mm = detectColumns(ln, prof.requiredCols); if (mm) { colMap = mm; started = true; continue; } }
            if (!started || !colMap) continue;
            if (stopLine(ln.text)) { started = false; continue; }
            var row = rowFromColumns(ln, colMap);
            // A price-list row = part/desc + a money value (qty is usually absent).
            if ((row.partNum || (row.description && row.description.length > 1)) && (row.unitPrice != null || row.amount != null)) items.push(row);
            else if (items.length && row.qty == null && row.unitPrice == null && row.amount == null) {
                var cont = ((row.partNum ? row.partNum + ' ' : '') + (row.description || '')).trim();
                if (cont && cont.length <= 90 && !/^page\s+\d+/i.test(cont))
                    items[items.length - 1].description = (items[items.length - 1].description + ' ' + cont).trim();
            }
        }
    });
    // The money column on a price list is the unit price.
    items.forEach(function (it) { if (it.unitPrice == null && it.amount != null) it.unitPrice = it.amount; });

    var out = { vendorName: '', customerName: '', poNumber: '', vendorPo: '', orderDate: '', shipDate: '', lineItems: items, totals: {}, rawText: text };
    if (prof.entity === 'vendor') out.vendorName = entName || ''; else out.customerName = entName || '';
    return out;
}

// ============================================================================
//  SPREADSHEET INTAKE  (CSV native · Excel via SheetJS) + COLUMN MAPPING
//  ----
//  A CSV / .xlsx / .xls is a clean grid, so instead of the geometry parser we
//  let the user MAP each spreadsheet column to an order field. Columns are
//  auto-guessed from the header row (reusing COL_KEYS), then editable in a
//  mapping bar above the review. Every mapping change rebuilds the parsed order
//  live. The doc-type selector still chooses the profile (SO / receiving /
//  price list); the mapped fields adapt to it.
// ============================================================================
function readText(file) {
    return new Promise(function (res, rej) {

// RFC-4180-ish CSV → 2D array (quoted fields, "" escapes, newlines in quotes).
function parseCsv(text) {

    for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        var ch = text[i];
        if (inQ) {
            if (ch === '"') { if (text[i + 1] === '"') { cur += '"'; i++; } else inQ = false; }
            else cur += ch;
        } else if (ch === '"') inQ = true;
        else if (ch === ',') { row.push(cur); cur = ''; }
        else if (ch === '\n') { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); row = []; cur = ''; }
        else cur += ch;
    }
    if (cur !== '' || row.length) { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); }
    while (rows.length && rows[rows.length - 1].every(function (c) { return String(c).trim() === ''; })) rows.pop();
    return rows;
}

function guessColumn(header, keys, used) {

        var h = String(header[i] == null ? '' : header[i]).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9%#\/ ]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (!h) continue;

function dpSheetAutoDetect() {

    for (var r = 0; r < scan; r++) {
        var row = grid[r] || [], matched = {};
        row.forEach(function (cell) {

            if (!h.trim()) return;

            });

    var sh = DP.sheet, grid = dpSheetGrid();

// ============================================================================
//  CREATE SALES ORDER  (ImportSalesOrder CSV → /api/import/Sales-Order)
//  ----
//  Mirrors QuickOrder.htm's buildImportPayload/submitSoImport exactly: two
//  header rows (SO cols, Item cols) + one SO data row + N item rows. There is
//  no REST POST /api/sales-orders (returns 405); the import endpoint is the
//  supported path.
// ============================================================================
var SO_COLS = ['Flag', 'SONum', 'Status', 'CustomerName', 'CustomerContact',
    'BillToName', 'BillToAddress', 'BillToCity', 'BillToState', 'BillToZip', 'BillToCountry',
    'ShipToName', 'ShipToAddress', 'ShipToCity', 'ShipToState', 'ShipToZip', 'ShipToCountry',
    'ShipToResidential', 'CarrierName', 'TaxRateName', 'PriorityId', 'TotalIncludesTax',
    'PONum', 'VendorPONum', 'Date', 'Salesman', 'ShippingTerms', 'PaymentTerms', 'FOB', 'Note',
    'QuickBooksClassName', 'LocationGroupName', 'OrderDateScheduled', 'URL', 'CarrierService',
    'CurrencyName', 'CurrencyRate', 'PriceIsHomeCurrency', 'DateExpired', 'Phone', 'Email', 'Category'];
var ITEM_COLS = ['Flag', 'SOItemTypeID', 'ProductNumber', 'ProductDescription', 'ProductQuantity',
    'UOM', 'ProductPrice', 'Taxable', 'TaxCode', 'Note', 'ItemQuickBooksClassName',
    'ItemDateScheduled', 'ShowItem', 'KitItem', 'RevisionLevel', 'CustomerPartNumber'];

function csvField(v) { if (v == null) return '""'; return '"' + String(v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }

// Encode header-column array(s) + data rows into Fishbowl import CSV lines.
// SO passes two header arrays ([SO_COLS, ITEM_COLS]); single-row-type imports
// (receiving, vendor/customer parts) pass one.
function buildImportCsv(headerColArrays, dataRows) {
    var enc = function (a) { return a.map(csvField).join(','); };
    return headerColArrays.map(enc).concat(dataRows.map(enc));
}

// POST an import CSV to Fishbowl. Prefers REST (/api/import/<Slug>), falls back
// to the legacy ImportRq bridge (Type = 'Import' + slug without dashes). Throws
// on a non-1000 legacy result. Slug e.g. 'Sales-Order' → 'ImportSalesOrder'.
async function postImportCsv(slug, rows) {
    var body = rows.join('\n');
    if (typeof runRestApiAsync === 'function') {
        var r = await runRestApiAsync({ method: 'POST', path: '/api/import/' + slug, body: body, contentType: 'text/plain' });
        debugLog('REST /api/import/' + slug + ' → ' + JSON.stringify(r), 'success');
        return r;
    }
    if (typeof runApiRequest === 'function') {
        var typeName = 'Import' + slug.replace(/-/g, '');
        var raw = runApiRequest('ImportRq', JSON.stringify({ ImportRq: { Type: typeName, Rows: { Row: rows } } }));
        var resp = typeof raw === 'string' ? safeParse(raw) : raw;
        var flat = JSON.stringify(resp || {}).toLowerCase();
        var ok = /statuscode"\s*:\s*"?1000/.test(flat) || /"success"\s*:\s*true/.test(flat);
        if (!ok) throw new Error(extractImportError(resp) || 'Import did not return success');
        debugLog('Legacy ImportRq ' + typeName + ' → ' + JSON.stringify(resp), 'success');
        return resp;
    }
    throw new Error('No import transport (runRestApiAsync / runApiRequest) is available.');
}

// Resolve the active address for one side of the order: an address on file, or
// the components parsed from the document (the SO stores address TEXT, so a
// doc-sourced address doesn't need to exist in the address table).
function addrForCsv(kind) {
    var st = (kind === 'ship') ? DP.ship : DP.bill;
    var P = DP.parsed || {};
    var doc = (kind === 'ship') ? P.shipToParsed : P.billToParsed;
    var c = DP.selectedCustomer;
    if (st && st.source === 'doc' && doc) {
        return { recipient: (doc.name || (c && c.name) || ''), street: doc.street || '', city: doc.city || '',
                 state: doc.state || '', zip: doc.zip || '', country: doc.country || '', residential: false };
    }
    var a = DP.addresses.find(function (x) { return st && String(x.id) === String(st.fileId); });
    if (!a) return null;
    return { recipient: a.recipient || (c && c.name) || '', street: a.street, city: a.city, state: a.state,
             zip: a.zip, country: a.country, residential: !!a.residential };
}

function buildSoCsv() {
    var c = DP.selectedCustomer;
    if (!c) return null;
    var ship = addrForCsv('ship');
    var bill = addrForCsv('bill');
    if (!ship || !bill) return null;
    var P = DP.parsed;
    var cd = DP.custDefaults || {};
    var om = DP.orderMeta || {};
    var status = (DP.soStatus === 20) ? 20 : 10;
    var today = moment().format(MOMENT_FMT);
    var scheduled = P.shipDate ? moment(P.shipDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD').format(MOMENT_FMT) : today;
    // Parsed contact (Attn line) becomes the SO contact + ship-to name.
    var contact = (P.contactName || '').trim();
    var shipName = contact || ship.recipient || c.name;

    var soRow = ['SO', '', status, c.name, shipName,
        bill.recipient || c.name, bill.street, bill.city, bill.state, bill.zip, bill.country,
        shipName, ship.street, ship.city, ship.state, ship.zip, ship.country,
        ship.residential ? 'true' : 'false', om.carrier || '', om.taxRate || '', cd.priorityId || 30, 'false',
        P.poNumber || '', P.vendorPo || '', today, om.salesman || '', om.shipTerms || '', om.paymentTerms || '', '', P._note || '',
        '', '', scheduled, '', om.carrierService || '', '', '', 'true', '', '', DP.selectedEmail || '', ''];

    var itemRows = P.lineItems
        .filter(function (it) { return (it.partNum || '').trim() && (it.qty != null); })
        .map(function (it) {
            // matchParts already normalised the line onto our product number; the
            // _match fallback covers a match that didn't rewrite.
            var num = (it._match && it._match.ok && it._match.partNum) ? it._match.partNum : it.partNum.trim();
            // Per-line tax code (taxrate.code) drives the SO item's tax; a line
            // carrying a code is Taxable, a "None" line is not.
            var taxCode = it.taxCode || '';
            return ['Item', 10, num, it.description || '', it.qty, it.uom || 'ea',
                it.unitPrice != null ? it.unitPrice : 0, taxCode ? 'true' : 'false', taxCode, '', '', '', 'true', '', '', it.customerNum || ''];
        });

    var rows = buildImportCsv([SO_COLS, ITEM_COLS], [soRow].concat(itemRows));
    return { rows: rows, body: rows.join('\n'), itemCount: itemRows.length };
}

async function dpCreateSO() {
    var built = buildSoCsv();
    if (!built) { showToast('Cannot build the order — check customer + addresses.', 'error', 5000); return; }
    if (!built.itemCount) { showToast('No sellable lines (each needs a part # and quantity).', 'error', 5000); return; }

    var statusLbl = (DP.soStatus === 20) ? 'Issued' : 'Estimate';
    if (!confirm('Create a ' + statusLbl + ' sales order for "' + DP.selectedCustomer.name + '" with ' + built.itemCount +
        ' line(s)?\n\nThis writes to Fishbowl via the sales-order import. The SO number will be auto-assigned.')) return;

    var btn = document.getElementById('createBtn');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Creating…'; }
    setStatus('Creating sales order…');
    debugLog('ImportSalesOrder rows=' + built.rows.length, 'info');
    built.rows.forEach(function (r, i) { debugLog('  row[' + i + '] ' + r, 'info'); });

    try {
        await postImportCsv('Sales-Order', built.rows);

        // The import doesn't echo the new SO number — look up the customer's latest.
        var newNum = null;
        try {
            var found = await qp("SELECT num FROM so WHERE customerId = " + parseInt(DP.selectedCustomer.id, 10) + " ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
            if (found && found.length) newNum = String(found[0].num);
        } catch (_) {}

        dpCreatedBanner(newNum);
        showToast('Sales order created' + (newNum ? ' — ' + newNum : ''), 'success', 5000);
        setStatus('Sales order created' + (newNum ? ' (' + newNum + ')' : '') + '.');
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('SO create failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'error');
        showToast('Create failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'error', 8000);
        setStatus('Create failed.');
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/></svg>Create Sales Order'; }
    }
}

'<button class="ps-btn" type="button" onclick="openModule(\'Sales Order\',\'' + numJs + '\')"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7-7 7M3 12h18"/></svg>Open ' + esc(newNum) + '</button>' : '') +
        '<button class="ps-btn primary" type="button" onclick="dpReset()"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Parse another</button>';
}

function safeParse(s) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (_) { return s; } }
function extractImportError(resp) {
    try {
        var s = JSON.stringify(resp);
        var m = s.match(/"statusMessage"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/i) || s.match(/"message"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
        return m ? m[1] : '';
    } catch (_) { return ''; }
}

    // and clear busy so a new document (or this reset) is always accepted — the

    DP.previewZoom = 1; DP._previewImg = null; DP._renderTask = null; showZoomNav(false);

    DP._candCache = null; DP.autoPicked = null; DP.ship = null; DP.bill = null; DP.custDefaults = null; DP.orderMeta = null; DP.taxAmount = 0; DP.soStatus = null;
    DP.defaultTaxCode = ''; DP.emails = null; DP.selectedEmail = '';   // customer + order-list + taxRates caches kept
    DP.selectedVendor = null; DP._vendCandCache = null; DP.vendAutoPicked = null; DP.openPOs = null; DP.selectedPO = null; DP.vendorPartIndex = null; DP.expectedCosts = null; DP._plCandCache = null;

        var apply = function () {
            var el = _debugApi.element;
            var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible'), open = el.classList.contains('is-open');

    }
}
